en:
You have to learn to magnify your natural appeal several
times over if you wanna make it.

And right now, you don't know how. That's the biggest
difference between you and your opponents.

You just need a little push in the right direction, and I'm
the perfect person to give it to you.

No time for questions! Now, show me your outfit! Come on,
let's see it!
Ow! You better hope that doesn't leave a mark!
It'll ruin our performance!
But you tripped Haruka!
I'd tone it down a little if I were you, hmm?

If you're looking to start something, though, just know we
won't hold back.
Step on our toes...
And we'll squash your little agency in no time flat.
What? You got something to say?
No wonder Dyna Chair can't hold on to any of its talent!

Horie-san, we don't have time for this. I have to get
changed.
Oh, so you think you can just walk away, do you!?
What do you intend to do about my arm!?
...Have you ever been to Okinawa?
Huh? What?
Okinawa. Have you ever been?
Nope, never... Why do you ask?
You'd like Okinawa. The sea is so pretty, and the air is clean and clear.
All your troubles will melt away. You should go sometime.
I could even tell you a few spots you wouldn't want to miss.
Let's go, Horie-san.
What's with her?

I think she was sayin' a little trip to Okinawa might cheer
you sourpusses up.
Wait a minute. Just what're you implying, Nakai-san!?
Hmm. Now I see what Park-san saw in her...
All right. That's enough, girls.
Huh!? You've got to be kidding me!
Haruka Sawamura...
Ooh, that girl really ticks me off.
Oh, man. I can't believe that happened...
I'm so sorry. I'll try to make up for it on the stage.
T-Set... What a buncha brats...

What's wrong with Osaka Talent, letting 'em get away with
that kind of behavior?

...Oh well, there's nothin' we can do about it now. Best you
go and get changed.
There's a room up here you can use, they said.
Here it is. Go ahead.

Oh, before you get changed, let's go say hello to the
producer, Manda-san.
More goons.
We got some work cut out for us.
Yeah. Let's deal with 'em. Come on!
Now tell me where I can find this Kanai.
What do ya want with him?
That's none of your business. Just tell me where he is.

I heard the Ousaka Enterprises office is about an hour's
drive from Sotenbori.
Ya might try lookin' there.
An hour, huh? That's pretty out of the way.

Of course it's outta the way, ya can't have that kinda place
on a downtown street corner.

Anyway, he's a director, so I bet he leaves the heavy
liftin' to his boys and just stays in the office doin' desk
work or somethin'.
Desk work? Him? I'm havin' a hard time picturing that...
In any case, it looks like I'll have to go pay him a visit.
By the way, I'd rather not see you boys again.
Got a problem with that?
Fine. I'm sick of seein' your face anyway.
We finally agree on something.

(This Ousaka Enterprises is pretty far. I guess I'll take a
cab. And if this Kanai guy is there, I'd better be
prepared...)
And just who might you be?

We just talked on the phone. I've been waiting for you,
Akiyama-san.

You bust into my office and you won't even tell me your
name? That's not very polite.

You don't think Mirei Park-san's death was a suicide, do
you?
I'll ask again. Who are you?
Let's just say I'm with the police.
You sure don't look it.

But whatever. What do the police want with me? And why all
the secrecy?
Why don't you just hear me out first?

The one who killed Park was a man named Ogita, a former
dance instructor at Dyna Chair.
With me so far?
Go on.

He's most likely the one who pushed Dyna Chair's Horie off
the roof as well.

But it's not just him. There's a certain organization
wrapped up in all this, as well.
They're the ones I'm after.

The one pulling the strings on this thing is Ousaka
Enterprises⑬an Omi Alliance front company, and a powerful
one at that.
Ousaka Enterprises... Backed up by the Omi Alliance, you say?

This Ousaka Enterprises is a slippery fish. They don't let
themselves get caught.

Its executive director, a man named Kamon Kanai, has been
running around doing their dirty work.
That's about all the police have learned.
Kanai, huh?
Ogita was apparently working for this Kanai.

Kanai is also the one who used a forger to fabricate Park's
suicide note.
So he's our man, is he?

After the Park incident, we left those two at large. We've
had them under surveillance ever since.
The Omi Alliance is a ticking time bomb right now. They're all scrambling to get in line for the chairman's spot, so anything could happen.

Not a good time to go sticking your nose into their
business, if you ask me.

Really? It sounds a whole lot more like you're begging me to
do the exact opposite.
Just what are you after, anyway?
You've been warned, Akiyama-san.
Sheesh... I've got people crawling out of the woodwork everywhere I go.
Ousaka Enterprises and the Omi Alliance...
Park-san... Just what did you get yourself involved with?
How's business, Sky Finance-han?
You boys again? I thought I told you I'm a very busy man...

Wait a minute. Hakamada-san, was it? Didn't you say you were
with the Omi Alliance?
That's right. And ya better learn to show some respect.
Good timing!

There's this fellow, the executive director of Ousaka
Enterprises, a front company of the Omi Alliance...
He goes by the name of Kanai. Think you can take me to him?
Ousaka Enterprises!? Where'd ya hear that name?
Can you take me or not?
You just took this way beyond us gettin' revenge.
Ah, so you have heard of them.
Hey, I dunno what you're tryin' to dig up here, pal, but now that you said that name...
I'd say you just dug your own grave! Time to die!

(It's time I paid a visit to Osaka Talent. Think I'll take a
taxi.)

(I have to get ready for the Princess League. I should get
back to Dyna Chair first.)
You can now change characters.

Select "Select Character" from the hideout menu or talk to
the character you want to change to.

I'm certain we'll find Kan Ogita sooner than later. We've
put out an emergency alert all over Osaka.

That's as a material witness for the assault and attempted
murder of Hiroshi Horie-san, however.

I don't think we'll be able to bring him up on charges for
the Mirei Park incident.
Why not? Look, it's like I said.
There was trouble between Ogita and Park-san.

Isn't that a critical fact in the investigation of her
death?

Yes, well, the Park incident has already been declared a
suicide.
And with the police having made that conclusion...
It'd be hard to reopen the investigation based on that piece of information alone.

Seriously...? But there was a yakuza with a gun there and
everything!
It wouldn't make any sense to <Italic>not</Italic> suspect Ogita.
Well, we'll get to the bottom of all that once we catch him.

Please leave the rest to the police. We can't have civilians
getting involved...
It's just too dangerous. Understand?

Apparently, they don't believe Ogita had anything to do with
Park-san's death.
Oh, thanks for going shopping for me.

Without Hana-chan here, I don't have any decent food or
drinks in the office.

Am I allowed to ask a famous idol to do that kind of stuff
for me?
I'm not famous. I'm just an ordinary high school student.
What are you going to do next?

Well, we can't just sit on our hands and hope the police
find Ogita, right?
But it wouldn't be very productive for us to try and do the same as the police, either.
If only there was something else we could do...
Akiyama-san, do you know of any forgers around here?
A forger, huh? What do you know about forgers?
A long time ago, when I first met Uncle Kaz...

I heard him talking about a man who did that kind of thing
for a living.
I've been thinking about Park-san's note...
There must be a forger somewhere here in Sotenbori, too.

Hmm. You might be on to something. Anybody can fake
someone's handwriting, but it'd take more than an amateur to fool police evaluation.
A professional forger would definitely do the trick, though.

Good thinking, Haruka-chan. If we find a forger here in
Sotenbori, he might lead us to Ogita and that guy with the gun.
Let me ask around and see what I can find out.
Hello? This is Haruka.
Haruka, ya got a second?
Oh, Yamaura-san. How is Horie-san...?

He'll be in the hospital for a good while, but he's gonna
make it. Don't worry.
He won't be able to manage you anymore, of course.
Poor Horie-san...
I can always try and fill his shoes, if you want.
What? You'd do that for me?
Hey, I want to see what happens to that dream of yours too, kiddo.
Besides, when I think of Horie-kun and Park-san...

I know that you makin' the debut they worked so hard for
would mean the absolute world to them.
Oh, thank you, Yamaura-san!

Also, this is kind of sudden, but I got a call sayin'
they're doing round two of the finals.
Really? But wouldn't it look bad if I went on?

Manda-san heard about Park-san, but he still wants you to go
on, he said.
He does? Okay.
Think ya can do it?
Yes. Of course.
Good. Glad to hear it.

Okay, then. I'll be waiting for you at Dyna Chair. Come on
over when you're ready.
All right, I will. Thank you!
Quite the busy little bee, aren't you, Haruka-chan?
No I'm not...
Chief, can you talk?
Oh, hi, Hana-chan. Yeah, sure.
What's the status on the Park-san situation?
Uh, let's maybe save that discussion for another time, shall we?
Oh, yeah! Sorry to drop this on you out of the blue...
But do you think you can track down a forger in Kamurocho for me?
A forger!? Chief, just what are you up to this time?

And what in the world does it have to do with opening the
new branch!?

Well, nothing really... but it is something I need taken
care of.
Well, take care of it yourself! You can leave me out of it!
Aw, don't be like that. I'm begging you!

Forget it! I've got work up to my ears over here, with you
being gone.

Why does everything but actual work always come first with
you!?
Please, Hana-chan? I'll bring you back some steamed buns.
Steamed buns?
That's right. A hundred of them!
Fine. Just this one last time!

You're the best, Hana-chan! Now, about this Kamurocho
forger... Think you can find him by tomorrow?

Did you forget who you're talking to? I'll have it done in
an hour.

That's my Hana-chan! Could you have him call my cell? I want
to talk to him.

That ought to move things along. The best way to find a
forger is to ask another forger.

I'll wait for Hana-chan to call back. You'd better get going
on the Princess League thing.
We can meet up at Dyna Chair later.
All right. Sounds good.
What's the matter, Akiyama-san? You look worried.
Haruka-chan's hiding something.
What? What do you mean?
She's been acting funny ever since she woke up.
Maybe Katsuya already made a move.
Wait. Perhaps...

Before I went into the room to check on Haruka, I believe I
heard her say something about "Shin-Osaka Station."
Shin-Osaka Station? Was she talking on the phone, maybe?
I'm not even sure if that's what she really said.
But we don't have any other leads, so here's hoping.
I'm going after her!
This is Haruka Sawamura-san, isn't it?
Yes. I saw your message. Who are you?
This is Katsuya, president of Osaka Talent.
What do you want with me!?

I want you to give me the letter Park-san received from her
ex-husband.
I know you have it.
Why would I ever give it to you!? I won't do it!
You seem to think we were the ones who killed Park-san.
I don't suppose anything I say will change your mind.

And in that case, as much as I hate to do it, I'll have to
resort to threats.
Threats!?
I looked into your background.

I was interested to see where Park-san found such an
exceptional talent.

You came from Okinawa, isn't that right? And you were raised
in a facility called Morning Glory Orphanage.
Yes, that's right. So what?
Imagine my surprise when I learned the name of its previous manager.

Kazuma Kiryu. I couldn't believe you had ties with the
legendary Dragon of Dojima.
It's been a few years since the war with the Tojo Clan.

But there are still many in the Omi Alliance who bear a
grudge against him.

If his whereabouts were made known, some might try to get
their revenge.

They might even try to use the Morning Glory Orphanage to
try and draw him out.
No! Morning Glory doesn't have anything to do with this!
Ah, but that's the nature of threats, isn't it?

What do you say? Are you willing to trade that letter for
Kiryu-san and the Morning Glory Orphanage?
